scripts.dev:turbo: node scripts/ensure-node-for-next-dev.mjs && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings next dev -p 3001
scripts.dev:poll: node scripts/ensure-node-for-next-dev.mjs && cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings next dev --webpack -p 3001
scripts.dev:docker: docker run --rm -it -p 3001:3001 -v "$PWD":/app -v /app/node_modules -w /app node:22-bookworm-slim bash -lc 'npm install && NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings exec npx next dev --webpack -p 3001 -H 0.0.0.0'
